title: Avalore
description: A fantasy roleplay server with inspirations from The Witcher and Final Fantasy, equipped with RPG-combat mechanics and collaborative storytelling.
body:
> The air itself seems different. We made it to the first settlement by sunset — and have been met by nothing. No signs of life, no signs of a fight, no signs of fleeing. Everyone is just ... gone. We've been looking for wagon tracks in the mud, but so far have found little. We head further south at the break of dawn. . . .

Venture forth, brave pioneer, into the untamed wilderness of the Southern Reach, where the whispers of the enigmatic Aedall echo through the ancient forests and across the misty plains. This is a land steeped in mystery, where the remnants of a magical society—once ruled by a powerful and wise people—lie hidden beneath layers of time and legend. Their civilization has since vanished, leaving behind only cryptic ruins and arcane secrets for those that have taken up their abandoned lands.

Welcome to Avalore, a fantasy-touched medieval world brimming with adventure and rich, hand-crafted lore. Here, the very air is thick with the presence of magic, and the landscape is dotted with the remnants of curses and blessings. The world is as much a character in your journey as the people and creatures who inhabit it—a realm where every shadow might conceal a story, and every glade might harbor a guardian or a specter from the past.

In this vibrant setting, you are more than just a participant; you are a creator, a storyteller shaping your destiny. Avalore offers a unique blend of freeform roleplay and tabletop-inspired gameplay, where custom plugins enhance your experience. Regardless of who you are, the world responds to your actions, offering new challenges, rewards, and opportunities to grow.

Forge alliances, meet allies and make enemies, and explore a world where the mystical and the mundane collide. Avalore is not just a setting; it is a living, breathing world that evolves with every decision you make. The secrets of the Aedall are waiting to be uncovered—what role, what part will you play in this new venture in community story telling? The path is yours to walk, the story yours to write.

Adventure awaits in the Southern Reach. Will you heed the call?
